_comment: Trident Tide-Race grant — the Tide-Caller's Trident (Riptide III, unbreakable) handed out at the start of every trident race (trident_race/start.mcfunction) and kept after the first clean run. Riptide III gives the strongest dash through the ocean rings; riptide only fires while the wielder is IN water or rain (the course is submerged). set_name aqua, dyed n/a (trident has no dye). Component shape is 1.21.1 — verify in-game.
